meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按代码结构而非文本,在 25 种语言中查找/改写代码:按形态匹配函数、调用或导入,做确定性改写(如 console.log→logger.info),也支持 YAML 规则;改写前先干跑预览。
howto.when: 当需求依赖代码结构而非文本时触发,例如按形态找函数/调用/导入、把某种写法批量迁移成另一种、运行 YAML 规则扫描;纯字符串、注释、文件名等改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按结构搜索并显示匹配位置。

say.text: 把 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x),先预览
把 require(...) 迁移成 import
say.note: 预览确认后可批量改写。

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax shape (AST) in 25 languages: match functions/calls/imports by form, apply rewrites (e.g. console.log -> logger.info), scan YAML rules, and default to a dry-run preview before changing files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task depends on code structure, not raw text: find functions/calls/imports by shape, migrate one syntax to another repo-wide, run YAML rules. Plain strings, comments, or filenames use rg/grep instead.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Runs an AST search and previews matches.

say_en.text: Rewrite all console.log(x) to logger.info(x), preview first
